description: A material factual claim with only context_only citations. Tests the rule that context-only support is not support.

claim.claim_text: Adoption of this technique reduced defect rates by approximately 40% across the industry.

evidence_span.quoted_text: [rights-cleared excerpt] Defect reduction remains a central concern for the sector.
[rights-cleared excerpt] Several plants have trialled the approach.

expected.required_action: mark as unsupported in the output and list in the unsupported-claim report, or remove

findings.reason: All citations are context_only. Neither establishes the 40% figure or the industry-wide scope. A claim supported only by context is unsupported.

pass_condition: The claim is classified unsupported and appears in the unsupported-claim list. Treating two context_only citations as cumulative support is a fixture failure.
